verdict.rationale: New Relic documents background automations: alert conditions evaluate signals against thresholds or anomalies and route notifications on their own (docs-5, docs-33, docs-34), synthetic monitors simulate user activity and API calls without anyone present (docs-19), and a vulnerability-management agent triages CVEs, drafts remediation, and opens Jira or GitHub issues (docs-41). The broader 'automated remediation' claim is marketing copy only (docs-46). Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose engine for user-defined autonomous workflows, evidence of automated remediation actions beyond notifications and tickets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
